entries.question: OPD me registration karane ki timing kya hoti hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD registration (parchi counter) ka samay is prakar hai:

*   **Somvar (Monday) se Shukravar (Friday):** Subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak.
*   **Shanivar (Saturday):** Subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 12:00 baje tak.
*   **Ravivar (Sunday):** OPD band rehti hai.

**Kuch mahatvapurn baatein:**
1.  **Online Registration:** KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jaakar apna appointment book kar sakte hain.
2.  **Walk-in:** Agar aap seedhe counter par jaate hain, toh apna **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** zaroor saath rakhein, kyunki registration ke liye mobile par OTP aana zaruri hai.
3.  **Kripya dhyan dein:** Counter dopahar 1:00 baje (Shanivar ko 12:00 baje) sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahle pahunchna behtar hai.

Agar aapko kisi medical samasya ke liye salah chahiye, toh main aapko salah dunga ki aap kisi qualified doctor se milein ya KGMU OPD mein sampark karein. Kripya is chat mein apni koi bhi vyaktigat (personal) jankari ya medical details share na karein.

entries.answer:

*   **OPD/Hospital registration fee receipt?**
*   **University/Examination/Academic fee receipt?**

If you are a student, you can generally access your payment details through the student portal or by contacting your respective department office. If you are a patient, the receipt is typically generated at the time of payment at the registration counter.

Please provide more context so I can guide you to the correct link or office.

entries.question: Academic
entries.answer:
For academic and examination-related fee receipts, you should primarily check the **Student Portal** or the specific office handling your course. 

Since there is no single "public" download link for all student fee receipts, please follow these steps:

1.  **Student Portal/MIS:** Most students can log in to the official KGMU student management system/portal. Once logged in, look for a section labeled "Fee Details," "Payment History," or "My Receipts."
2.  **Departmental Office:** If you cannot find the receipt on the portal, please contact the **Office of your respective Dean** (Faculty of Medical Sciences or Faculty of Dental Sciences). They maintain the records for all tuition and examination fees paid.
3.  **Finance/Registrar Office:** If the payment was made via an online gateway or bank challan, you may need to check the **Registrar Office** (0522-2253171) for verification if the receipt was not generated or emailed to you at the time of transaction.

**Important Note:** 
*   If you are asking about a specific **Examination Result** or related fee, you can check the status at: [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php)
*   For official guidelines, you can visit: [https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php](https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php)

If you are a student, I recommend logging into your university-provided email or student dashboard first, as payment confirmations are often sent there automatically.

*   **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text `"APPOINTMENT <Your Name>"` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in (On-Site):** You can visit the registration counter at the hospital. 
    *   *Requirements:* You must have your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration.
    *   *Fee:* ₹50 (payable at the counter).

*   **Timing:** The OPD registration counters are open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Monday–Friday) and 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Saturday). They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Safety:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.
